disposition_mapping.rationale: The kickoff mechanics (calendar trigger, macro-indicator pull, template distribution) are automated, but the judgment content — corporate-target framing, macro selection, known-event flagging — is retained with a named accountable FP&A manager confirm/amend gate and a recorded rationale log, per the majority (finance_domain, hitl_designer, emerging_economy, pragmatist, accounting_standards) rejecting maximalist's proposal to dissolve this into a parameterless continuous system. The mechanical half of RF-03 (FX, run-rate refresh) is absorbed here so the assumptions pack issued to BUs already carries fresh mechanical drivers, closing the staleness gap finance_domain identified.

The council's majority (pragmatist, emerging_economy, finance_domain, hitl_designer, accounting_standards) held that actuals ingestion must remain a distinct, dated function anchored by a hard period-lock gate, against maximalist/agentic_architect's proposal to dissolve it into an undifferentiated continuous feed. The step is retained but heavily automated: extraction and mapping run as an agent pipeline, the cutoff/period-lock discipline (KB-03) is enforced as a non-bypassable precondition, exceptions route to a named analyst, and a maintained manual fallback plus periodic sampling audit address the uneven data-quality risk emerging_economy raised.

Following finance_domain's 'shadow reconciliation loop' diagnosis — adopted with concessions by maximalist, hitl_designer, agentic_architect and emerging_economy — the blended mechanical/judgment step is split rather than preserved as a standalone activity. The mechanical portion (FX, run-rate roll-forwards) is absorbed into TS-01 as calendar-triggered automated refresh, with the FX component kept separately traceable per KB-08 and accounting_standards' non-negotiable. The judgment portion (pricing, volume, headcount-cost inflation) is merged into TS-03, so the same person who owns the forecast also originates the assumption, with an explicit accept/override requirement (per agentic_architect/hitl_designer's correction) preventing silent auto-population.

BU forecast submission remains irreducibly human-owned, local judgment, as every council member agreed. It now also carries the judgment half of RF-03 (see above), collapsing a duplicate judgment loop without removing any accountable act. Multi-channel access (portal and spreadsheet) with identical validation rules is preserved per emerging_economy's non-negotiable, and real-time plausibility/outlier flagging is added per hitl_designer/agentic_architect, without adopting maximalist's 'machine drafts, human edits only deviations' model, which emerging_economy showed would quietly relocate authorship away from BU leads.

Consolidation arithmetic and rule-based coherence checks are automated with exception-only human touch, following the convergent view of maximalist, finance_domain, hitl_designer and agentic_architect against pragmatist's insistence on a blanket human sign-off over clean-passed output. The council resolved this conflict in favour of exception-based accountability plus mandatory periodic sampling audit (hitl_designer's non-negotiable), on the grounds that a blanket sign-off over unreviewed data manufactures the appearance of oversight without its substance. FPA-R-02's requirement that consolidation keep consuming closed-period actuals is preserved as a mandatory, machine-checked input binding, and a distinct methodology-drift check satisfies KB-06 independent of tie-out-focused anomaly detection, per accounting_standards' hold.

FPA-R-01 requires variance analysis to survive; the council majority (pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, emerging_economy, agentic_architect, accounting_standards) rejected maximalist's proposal to fuse it into a live analytic layer inside the review meeting, holding that the preparation window before the meeting is where a machine-generated bridge actually gets checked before it reaches the decision-maker. The step is retained as a distinct, analyst-authored deliverable with bridge arithmetic agent-generated and the narrative/risk-opportunity judgment human-authored, with FX effects kept separately visible per KB-08.

FPA-R-03 requires this function to survive. The council decisively rejected maximalist's proposed materiality-threshold delegation (pragmatist, finance_domain, emerging_economy, hitl_designer, agentic_architect all held against it, and accounting_standards found no standards basis to endorse it), on the grounds that a threshold clearing variances without a specific human decision event is the absence of the accountability act, not a smaller version of it. The step is retained as a single, undelegated CFO/FP&A director gate, strengthened by requiring the reviewer be shown the assumption-change log and exception queue rather than a headline figure.

FPA-R-05 requires publication to survive, and FPA-R-04 requires it strictly after approval. The council converged (pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, agentic_architect) on automating publication mechanics while hard-gating the publish action on a system-emitted approval token rather than procedural convention. The token/period-lock class of control gate is deliberately not given a bypass path (per agentic_architect's distinction between data channels and control gates); instead, technical failure of the gating infrastructure triggers a stall-and-alert escalation to a named accountable role who manually verifies the underlying approval occurred, resolving the conflict finance_domain raised between hard-gating and pragmatist's fallback requirement without weakening either.

steps.description: On the rolling-calendar trigger, an orchestration agent pulls macro indicators via feed, refreshes mechanical drivers (FX rates, actual run-rate rollforwards) absorbed from the former driver-update step, and drafts the assumptions pack and timetable/templates. The FP&A manager remains the accountable actor for a confirm/amend gate over the judgment content only — corporate-target framing, macro-indicator selection, known-event flagging — recording an explicit rationale log before distribution, so the confirmation act is never a passive sign-off. The exchange-difference component of the FX refresh is tagged and carried forward as a separately identifiable figure, never blended into a single 'rate change' number, so it remains extractable for the variance bridge downstream.
steps.name: Forecast cycle initiation and assumptions governance
outputs: Assumptions pack issued with rationale log
Mechanically refreshed FX/run-rate drivers, FX component separately tagged

steps.actor: FP&A analyst (exception owner, supported by ingestion agent)
steps.description: GL and management-reporting extraction, mapping to forecast structure, and completeness/consistency validation run as a scheduled agent pipeline. The pipeline is hard-gated on a period-lock/subledger-close signal: absent that signal it stalls and alerts, it does not proceed on provisional data. Failures and mapping breaks route to a named FP&A analyst exception queue rather than blocking the whole cycle. Revenue-recognition timing embedded in actuals is validated automatically so remapping into forecast structure does not implicitly re-time revenue. A maintained, tested manual/offline extraction path exists for entities with unreliable connectivity or immature source systems, applying the identical validation ruleset and producing a logged artifact indistinguishable in shape from the automated path. Clean-passed data is additionally subject to periodic sampling audit, since exception rules tuned on head-office-quality data will not reliably surface plausible-looking bad data from thinner-capability entities. Analysts formerly performing manual extraction shift to exception handling, sampling audit and pipeline oversight, with a stated retraining/transition plan rather than an assumed costless reallocation.
steps.name: Automated actuals ingestion with cutoff gate
outputs: Closed-period actuals (validated baseline) loaded to forecast model

steps.actor: BU finance leads (FP&A analyst provides template/tooling support)
steps.description: Judgment-based driver assumptions (pricing, volume/demand, headcount cost inflation) are originated once, directly by the BU finance lead at the point of submission, rather than pre-set centrally and then overridden — removing the shadow reconciliation loop where a central best-guess driver and the BU's actual number were judged twice by two different people. An agent pre-populates templates with the mechanical drivers from TS-01 and runs real-time completeness/plausibility and outlier checks at the point of entry. Every judgment-driver value requires an affirmative accept-or-override action, never a passive timeout-to-accept, and the rationale for the value used is retained as a distinct, visible artifact attached to the submission, not folded invisibly into a single number. Submission remains available through both an agent-assisted portal and a structured spreadsheet channel, with the identical validation ruleset applied to both, so channel choice does not create a capability or scrutiny gap between business units. Full revenue/cost/headcount/capex projections and commentary on changes since the prior forecast remain human-authored and locally accountable; a diff against the prior forecast is logged automatically for traceability.
steps.name: BU forecast and judgment-driver submission
outputs: Judgment-based driver assumptions with logged accept/override decision and rationale

steps.actor: FP&A analyst (exception owner, supported by consolidation agent)
steps.description: Consolidation arithmetic, intercompany matching, headcount-to-cost coherence and continuity-against-actuals checks run as an automated agent. The step's consumption of the validated closed-period actuals baseline is wired as a mandatory input binding, not a discretionary lookup: the agent cannot execute without it, satisfying the requirement that consolidation keep consuming closed-period actuals. Anything failing a validation rule is routed to a named FP&A analyst with the specific rule breached and supporting data; the agent never silently corrects or drops a submission, preserving the evidential trail. A separate, explicitly named methodology-drift check flags any change in computation or mapping logic even where output still reconciles internally, since a tie-out-focused exception queue will not by itself detect a consistent-but-changed method. Submissions that pass clean are not individually re-signed by a human — accountability attaches to what was actually examined, not to a blanket attestation over unreviewed data — but clean-passed output is subject to periodic sampling audit to guard against the rule-set itself drifting or missing new failure modes.
steps.name: Consolidation and exception-based validation
outputs: Methodology-drift and anomaly flags cleared or escalated

steps.description: Retained as a distinct, analyst-owned step with real preparation time preceding the review meeting, preserving the investigation window in which driver-level movements are actually explained and a machine-generated bridge is checked before a decision-maker sees it. Mechanical bridge arithmetic and driver-by-driver, prior-forecast-to-current attribution are agent-generated from the validated consolidation. The FP&A analyst authors the narrative explanation, curates the risk/opportunity schedule, and is the accountable source of the 'why' that management relies on. FX-driven movement is decomposed as a separately visible line from volume, price and mix effects, never folded into an undifferentiated variance bucket. Both the machine draft and the human-edited final are retained in the log, so the analyst's edit is itself visible evidence that judgment was exercised before the number reached the review session.
steps.name: Variance analysis

steps.description: Retained unchanged in substance as a single, undelegated human decision gate exercised over every cycle's full output — no materiality-threshold auto-clearance of 'routine' variances. This was a deliberate rejection of tiered or delegated approval: a threshold that lets a cycle's variances clear without a specific human examining that cycle's number is the absence of the accountability act the requirement protects, not a smaller version of it. The CFO/FP&A director is shown the assumption-change log, the consolidation exception queue and the risk/opportunity detail alongside the variance narrative, not a rolled-up headline figure, so the challenge session engages the substance rather than rubber-stamping a summary. Directed revisions are incorporated and the session concludes with a signed, logged approval token that becomes the forecast baseline of record.
steps.name: Management review and approval

steps.description: Restructured into an automated publish-and-archive agent, hard-gated on the signed approval token emitted by TS-06: no token, no publish, enforcing approval-before-publication as a machine-checked precondition rather than a process convention. If the token-emission or publication infrastructure itself fails technically — as distinct from the approval decision not having occurred — the process stalls and alerts a named accountable role, who manually verifies the underlying approval and completes the archive/publish action through an audited manual procedure; this is a failure-mode escalation, not a bypass of the approval requirement. The FP&A manager retains narrow accountability for confirming the published pack and commentary match what was actually approved, including any directed revisions from the review session. The archive retains the assumptions log and the full agent action trail for the cycle.
steps.name: Publish forecast and archive
